what: I/O window: one shunt picks the 1 KB window the board answers in.
do: Fit the shunt beside a window no other card uses. The BIOS doesn't look for this board.

what: Across D2, the diode in the W65C22N's interrupt line.
do: Leave it. The W65C22N's interrupt output is open-drain: it only pulls the line low, so the board works as shipped and D2 isn't needed. To fit a part that drives its interrupt high as well as low, such as a W65C22S, cut JP1 so the interrupt goes through D2.
